name: WhatsApp
title: WhatsApp: Rouh's own Business number, through Meta's official Cloud API

permissions: takes the messages Meta posts to /hooks/whatsapp, each checked against the app secret before it is read; a message from anybody but the owner or a trusted contact the owner linked to a number is dropped
sends the answer to the owner's own message back to their number with the Cloud API, and never writes first (Meta's 24-hour rule)
touches.remove: rouh/whatsapp_chat.py, the whatsapp service in rouh/service_keys.py, /hooks/whatsapp in rouh/project/urls.py and rouh/web/gate.py, its section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html and this manifest.
